mapper.sql: SELECT p.breed_seed_produce_batch_id, p.breed_batch_id, p.variety_id, p.variety_name, p.crop_type, p.time, p.land_id, p.land_name, p.input_seed_quantity, p.produce_seed_quantrity, p.operator_id, p.operator_name, p.produce_status, (p.produce_seed_quantrity - IFNULL( (SELECT SUM(d.distribute_quantity) FROM breed_seed_distribute_detail d WHERE d.breed_seed_produce_batch_id = p.breed_seed_produce_batch_id), 0) ) AS remaining_quantity, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM breed_seed_produce p
mapper.select: SELECT p.produce_seed_quantrity - IFNULL(SUM(d.distribute_quantity), 0) AS remaining_quantity FROM breed_seed_produce p LEFT JOIN breed_seed_distribute_detail d ON p.breed_seed_produce_batch_id = d.breed_seed_produce_batch_id WHERE p.breed_seed_produce_batch_id = #{breedSeedProduceBatchId} GROUP BY p.breed_seed_produce_batch_id, p.produce_seed_quantrity
mapper.update: UPDATE breed_seed_produce SET update_time = NOW() WHERE breed_seed_produce_batch_id = #{breedSeedProduceBatchId} AND (produce_seed_quantrity - (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(distribute_quantity), 0) FROM breed_seed_distribute_detail WHERE breed_seed_produce_batch_id = #{breedSeedProduceBatchId})) >= #{distributeQuantity}
